The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward after resolving previous logic errors.
The iteration achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. Success was driven by the gpt-5.2 and claude-code integration, which correctly implemented the weighted-risk matrix logic. Future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the capacity-at-risk formula to maintain the 1.00 mean reward across varied datasets.
